svg.title: Audit integrity check: what it detects and what it does not
svg.desc: Audit integrity check: what it detects and what it does not. Recomputed over the whole audit log when the snapshot was taken.
svg.text: Audit integrity check: what it detects and what it does not
Recomputed over the whole audit log when the snapshot was taken.
Scope: the whole audit log, not just the events counted in the other audit charts.
Any edit to an audit row that does not also recompute the whole forward hash chain after
it, and any broken link in a chain.
The application role has no UPDATE or DELETE permission on audit rows (a database guard
The database owner can disable the guard and rewrite a whole chain consistently; that
would pass this check. It reports damage after the fact; it does not prevent anyone with
database owner access from changing rows.
Provenance: MEASURED at snapshot time (hashes recomputed) · SYNTHETIC demo data
